# TopfHelm LLM Information File
# https://topfhelm.com/llms.txt

Project: TopfHelm

Description:
TopfHelm is an independent music project focused on Dungeon Folk, Dungeon Synth, Dark Folk and Medieval-inspired music. The project also develops The Emerald Saga — an original dark medieval fantasy universe combining music, storytelling and illustrations.

Primary Topics:
- Dungeon Folk
- Dungeon Synth
- Medieval Music
- Dark Folk
- Medieval Fantasy
- Fantasy Music
- RPG Music
- Ambient Music
- Cassette Releases
- Independent Music

TopfHelm
